description: Automatic context-usage tracking, phase/milestone detection, and strategic compaction suggestions and state capture/restore for Claude Code sessions, plus context-mode detection.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/skills/context-mode/scripts/detect_mode.py || exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/skills/context-mode/scripts/detect_mode.py

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/post-compact-restore.py; fi

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/context-monitor.py; fi

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uv run --no-project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/pre-compact.py; fi
